message: It's time to be planning your year -end giving, and I hope you'll remember Wisdom International when you do. In 2027, our goal is to translate this Wisdom journey into 10 new languages. We're a nonprofit organization, and 100 % of our funding comes from individual donors like you. It's your support that makes this possible. To learn more or to make a gift, visit wisdomonline .org. There's a link in the show notes. Now here's Stephen.
